evaluator: Blind Stagebench phase-3 evaluator; measured the published build/ served at 127.0.0.1:5425 in headless Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844, hit-tested every control with a 5x5 elementFromPoint grid, and analysed the live audio graph by tapping the node feeding AudioDestinationNode.
summary: Deep, largely honest system underneath a broken deck layout. Engines are genuinely separate and measurably distinct (piano grand/electric/clav/digital spectral centroids 1835/1181/1544/853 Hz; organ B3 2nd harmonic -94.8 dB vs Vox -44.2 dB; six synth waveforms), one AudioContext, delay/reverb A/B cleanly. But .chassis{overflow:hidden} plus section content taller than its 215.6 px box buries 72 of 198 controls under the keybed: no organ model/percussion/rotary switches, no piano model/timbre/detail controls, no LFO or arpeggiator, no transpose/panic/split controls are reachable at 1440x900. Program recall changes the audio (B3 Gospel 0.517 RMS vs grand 0.017) but moves zero panel controls. The organ reads ON at load yet is silent until organ-on is cycled. B3 Gospel with 17 notes hard-clips at peak 1.671. Geometry, keybed and colour are excellent: 73/43/30 keys all inside the keybed, black-key fraction 0.6099, all five reference colours within deltaE 2.2.

evidence: Piano library measurably distinct at C4 (build served on 127.0.0.1:5425, analyser tapped on the node feeding AudioDestinationNode): spectral centroid Grand 1835 Hz / Electric 1181 Hz / Clav 1544 Hz / Digital 853 Hz, with different band envelopes (Grand peaks in 160-320 Hz at -54.6 dB, Digital at -41.7 dB).

Organ models are separate synthesis paths, not one voice relabelled: B3 harmonic profile [-41.1,-94.8,-118,...] is a near-pure tonewheel fundamental, Vox is [-40.6,-44.2,-61.1,...], Farf [-48.6,-57.7,-74.6,...], Pipe 1 [-44.4,-69.3,-86.2,...]. Raising the 1-foot drawbar (artifact/src/model/controls.ts:101) lifted the 8th harmonic from -147.9 dB to -63.8 dB.

Six synth waveforms produce six different timbres (centroids 1310/950/601/399/496/532 Hz, alternating even-harmonic-rich and odd-harmonic-only profiles); artifact/src/audio/synth-voices.ts is a separate 413-line engine from artifact/src/audio/organ-voices.ts and artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts.

Level matching between engines is poor: same note, same master level gives Grand 0.0165 RMS, Farf 0.0148, Vox 0.0745, B3 0.1078 — a 17 dB spread a player would have to ride the level knob to correct. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json also declares Pipe 2 reuses the B3 additive path, which the measurement confirms (both 0.10775 peak).

One shared context confirmed by instrumenting the AudioContext constructor before page load: window.__ctxCount === 1 after exercising piano, organ and synth; every path terminates in a single DynamicsCompressorNode connected to AudioDestinationNode.

Effects are individually audible and reversible on the shared chain: piano dry peak 0.01657 with tail [0.00358,0.00223,0.00053,0.00014,...]; delay on with feedback raised gives a regenerating tail [0.00159,0.00117,0.0013,0.00141,0.00124,0.00102,...]; switching both effects off restores 0.01657 with the identical dry tail.

Organ routing is not established at mount. On a fresh load organ-on reports aria-pressed="true" and organ-layer-a-enable="true", yet pressing C4 with the piano muted yields 0.00000 RMS. Cycling organ-on off/on with no other change yields 0.10775 RMS. Reproduced across three independent sessions.

Reverb behaves more like a wet/dry blend than a reverb: enabling it on the piano lowered the peak from 0.01657 to 0.01112 and shortened rather than extended the release tail (decay to inaudible 280 ms -> 210 ms).

Holding 17 computer-keyboard notes on program 1.4 (B3 Gospel) drives the output past full scale: peak sample 1.6712 with all 30 sampled analyser frames above 0.999 — measured at the output of the limiter that feeds AudioDestinationNode, so this is audible hard clipping, not headroom.
The same 17-note chord on the piano (peak 0.2704) and on 1.8 Super Lead (peak 0.3324) shows zero clipped frames, so the failure is the organ bus gain, not polyphony handling.

Voice lifecycle is clean under load: after releasing all 17 keys .key.is-down count returns to 0; dispatching a window blur while 6 notes are held drops output to 0.0000 RMS; program-panic silences and clears. No page errors or console errors were captured during the whole interaction pass.
Latency is reasonable — AudioContext baseLatency 5.33 ms, outputLatency 24 ms at 48 kHz.

Patch state genuinely round-trips in the audio: storing edits into slot 1.5 then reselecting it reproduced identical control values (0 differences over ~195 controls), and factory slots recall distinct sounds (1.4 B3 Gospel 0.51734 RMS / centroid 378 Hz, 1.8 Super Lead 0.02253 / 837 Hz, 1.7 Pipe Chapel 0.07079 / 512 Hz vs 1.1 Concert Grand 0.01653 / 1833 Hz).

The panel does not round-trip at all. Snapshotting aria-pressed/aria-valuenow for every [data-control-id] before and after selecting program 4 (B3 Gospel: pianoOn=false, organOn=true, percOn=true, rotaryOn=true per artifact/src/model/instrument-state.ts:713-724) gives 0 changed controls; organ-on, piano-on, organ-perc-on and rotary-on all keep their previous state while the audio switches.

Store cannot be completed with the documented two presses. artifact/src/model/apply-control.ts:193 gates on `value >= 1` while program-store is a latching LedButton, so press 2 toggles the value to 0 and is ignored — the OLED stays on "STORE 1.5" through program selects, Live Mode and page navigation. A third press commits.

The dirty flag itself is truthful: OLED reads "1.5 | VOX COMBO", becomes "1.5 E | VOX COMBO" after any edit, and clears on commit. Nothing persists across a reload (localStorage is empty after store; OLED returns to "1.1 CONCERT GRAND").

All three input paths reach a note lifecycle: pointer press on [data-key="60"] adds .is-down and sounds (0.01653 RMS); computer key "q" lights MIDI 60 and sounds 0.00921 RMS (map at artifact/src/input/keymap.ts:26); an injected Web MIDI port sending 0x90 40 100 lights key 64 and 0x80 releases it.

Pedal bindings work: Space sets #sustain-pedal aria-pressed="true", and MIDI CC64 >= 64 sets it too (artifact/src/input/midi.ts:100). CC11 is mapped to the control pedal (midi.ts:104), matching the IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS claim.

Most performance bindings are not operable from the panel. The 5x5 elementFromPoint hit-test at 1440x900 finds program-transpose-up/down, program-panic, program-split-low/mid/high, program-split-xfade, synth-arp-on/run/hold/dir/mode/rate/range and all synth LFO controls unreachable — they render below the deck and the keybed paints over them.

MIDI CC1 and pitch-bend messages are ignored (perf-mod-wheel stayed aria-valuenow="0" and perf-pitch-stick "0" after 0xB0 01 127 and 0xE0 00 100); artifact/src/input/midi.ts:86-107 handles only note on/off, CC64 and CC11.
Panic and global note-off are correct across engines: after 17 held notes on the organ program, program-panic returns 0.00000 RMS and 0 keys down; a window blur event with 6 keys held does the same.

Split state is modelled and displayed: enabling Split renders split LEDs at data-split-led="48" and "60" over the matching key positions (artifact/src/components/Keybed.tsx:88-97) and the OLED appends the split point ("1.1 E | CONCERT GRAND C4"). Layer Scene II toggles and reports aria-pressed="true".

The workflow is not drivable from the panel: program-split-low/mid/high and program-split-xfade all fail the 5x5 elementFromPoint probe, as do transpose up/down, so a user cannot set a split point or transpose without synthetic events.
Transpose marks the program dirty ("1.1" -> "1.1 E") but neither the OLED nor any panel element reports the transpose amount, so its value is unobservable.

The model is complete and audible: nine drawbars with correct footage legends and defaults 8/8/8/0/0/0/0/0/0 (artifact/src/model/controls.ts:93-101), five model switches, percussion volume/decay/harmonic, vibrato/chorus with type, rotary stop/fast/drive. Vibrato raised the peak from 0.10775 to 0.13689; rotary fast reshaped the harmonic tail; the 1-foot drawbar added the 8th harmonic (-147.9 dB -> -63.8 dB).

None of it is on the panel. Of the 19 organ model / preset / vibrato / percussion / rotary / assign controls, 0 pass the 5x5 elementFromPoint probe at 1440x900; a 3x screenshot of the ORGAN section shows only ON, layer enable/focus/level, octave and zone buttons plus a half-clipped drawbar row.
The organ is silent on a fresh load despite reporting ON (0.00000 RMS until organ-on is cycled), so the first thing a player hears from the section is nothing.
organ-preset-1 and organ-preset-2 are declared unsupported in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and confirmed inert, which is honest.

Oscillators, filter, envelopes, LFO, unison, voice mode and arpeggiator all exist in artifact/src/model/controls.ts:182-206 and 272-283 and reach the audio: six waveforms give centroids 1310/950/601/399/496/532 Hz, closing the filter moved the centroid from 1214 Hz to 688 Hz, and running the arpeggiator on a held key produced a repeating envelope [0.0105,0.0133,0.0143,0.0100,0.0079,...,0.0030,0.0035,0.0038,0.0038].

The section does not fit its box: 32 of the 54 synth controls render outside the 330.5x215.6 px synth section rect, and 22 fail the elementFromPoint probe — the entire LFO block (rate, amount, wave, destination, sync) and the entire arpeggiator block (on, run, hold, direction, mode, rate, range) are unreachable.
The synth OLED reads live: it showed "SAW | LP24 POLY" and tracked to "SINE" as the waveform encoder advanced.

Layer coverage matches the spec: organ and piano each expose A/B enable, focus and level; synth exposes A/B/C (artifact/src/model/controls.ts:171-179), and all of those are visible and reachable in the rendered deck.

Scenes, splits and morphs are implemented in the model — Layer Scene toggles to aria-pressed="true", split LEDs appear at MIDI 48 and 60, and 25 morph destinations are enumerated at artifact/src/model/instrument-state.ts:817-844 with a working wheel-assign latch.

Split points and the crossfade knob cannot be operated from the panel (program-split-low/mid/high and program-split-xfade all fail the 5x5 elementFromPoint probe), which is the phase-3 hard gate "splits, crossfades, scenes, morphs and layer routing are editable from the panel".

32 slots over 4 pages plus 8 Live slots all work: page up moved the OLED from "1.5" to "2.5", Live Mode showed "LIVE 1 | LIVE 1" and moved to "L2" on program 2, and Store As entered naming mode showing "STORE AS | VOX COMBO___".
Recall is cosmetic on the panel: selecting slot 4 or slot 8 changes the OLED label and the sounding audio but leaves all ~195 panel controls at their previous values (0 diffs measured).

The Store button must be pressed an odd number of times to commit because artifact/src/model/apply-control.ts:193 only acts on the rising edge of a latching toggle; two presses leave the instrument stuck showing "STORE".

issues.title: Section content overflows the deck and is buried under the keybed, making 72 of 198 controls unreachable
issues.detail: Each .section is a fixed-height flex child (215.6 px at 1440x900) but its children lay out to roughly twice that, and .chassis{overflow:hidden} (artifact/src/styles.css:56) plus the later-painting .keybed-shell hides everything past the deck. A 5x5 document.elementFromPoint probe over every [data-control-id] at 1440x900, page unscrolled, resolves 126/198. The casualties are whole landmark groups: all five organ model switches, all four percussion controls, all three rotary controls, organ vibrato, the piano model encoder, all four piano timbre knobs, both piano-detail switches, all four piano zone buttons, transpose up/down, panic, all three split points and the split crossfade, and the entire synth LFO and arpeggiator block. At 390x844 only 32/198 are reachable.

issues.title: Program recall updates the audio and the OLED but not a single panel control
issues.detail: Snapshotting aria-pressed/aria-valuenow for all 198 controls before and after selecting program 4 (B3 Gospel, which sets pianoOn=false, organOn=true, percOn=true, rotaryOn=true at artifact/src/model/instrument-state.ts:713-724) yields 0 differences, and the same for slot 8. The audio does change (0.51734 RMS / centroid 378 Hz vs 0.01653 / 1833 Hz), so the panel is actively reporting a state the instrument is not in — the honesty contract inverted.

issues.title: Organ is silent on load while its panel says ON
issues.detail: On a fresh page the organ section reports organ-on aria-pressed="true" and organ-layer-a-enable="true" with drawbars 8/8/8, yet pressing C4 with the piano muted measures 0.00000 RMS at the destination. Toggling organ-on off and on with nothing else changed produces 0.10775 RMS. Reproduced in three independent browser sessions.

issues.title: Organ programs hard-clip the output under normal polyphony
issues.detail: Holding 17 notes on program 1.4 (B3 Gospel) measures peak sample 1.6712 with 30 of 30 sampled frames above 0.999, taken at the output of the DynamicsCompressor that feeds AudioDestinationNode. The same chord on piano peaks at 0.2704 and on the synth lead at 0.3324. Per-engine level spread on a single note is 17 dB (Farf 0.0148 to B3 0.1078).

issues.title: Store never commits on the second press because it is gated on a latching toggle
issues.detail: artifact/src/model/apply-control.ts:193 runs beginStore only when value >= 1, but program-store is a LedButton that toggles 1/0. Press 1 enters store mode, press 2 sets the value to 0 and does nothing, so the OLED stays on "STORE 1.5" through program selects, Live Mode and page navigation until a third press. program-exit has the same shape.

issues.title: Rendered aspect ratio is 2.9994 against a 3.0951 target
issues.detail: The instrument box measures 1353.59 x 451.28 px at 1440x900. The element advertises data-aspect="3.0951" and .stage sets aspect-ratio (artifact/src/styles.css:42), but the rendered height exceeds what that ratio implies, putting the instrument 0.0957 outside the +/-0.06 tolerance and making the chassis noticeably squatter than the reference.

issues.title: Effects plate legends overlap and the rotary column is cut off at the chassis edge
issues.detail: The six section flex-bases sum to the deck content width while five 0.45% gaps are added on top, so the sections overrun the deck by ~29.7 px and the effects section ends at x=1410.6 against a chassis right edge of 1396.8. In the rendered deck "COMPRESSOR ON" prints over the DELAY column and "REVERB BRIGHT" over "ROTARY SPEAKER DRIVE".

issues.title: MIDI CC1 and pitch bend are ignored
issues.detail: artifact/src/input/midi.ts:86-107 handles note on/off, CC64 and CC11 only. Sending 0xB0 01 127 and 0xE0 00 100 to an injected input port left perf-mod-wheel and perf-pitch-stick at aria-valuenow="0". Note on/off and sustain do work end to end.

evidence: Measured on the served build at 1440x900: instrument rect x=43.20 y=208.66 w=1353.59 h=451.28. deckFraction = (keybedShell.y 452.27 - inst.y 208.66) / 451.28 = 0.5398 (target 0.54 +/-0.025); keybedFraction = 0.4602 (target 0.46).
widthFraction = 1353.59 / 1440 = 0.9400, inside [0.88, 0.97]. The page does not scroll (documentElement.scrollHeight 900 at a 900 px viewport).

aspectRatio = 1353.59 / 451.28 = 2.9994 against the 3.0951 +/-0.06 target from inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.variants.json — 0.0957 out, the only geometry miss. The element advertises data-aspect="3.0951" but the rendered box is taller than that, so the CSS aspect-ratio at artifact/src/styles.css:42 is being overridden.

Six section widths measured from [data-section] rects: 185.06 / 264.38 / 112.36 / 165.23 / 330.47 / 264.38 px against a 1351.59 px deck = 0.1369 / 0.1956 / 0.0831 / 0.1223 / 0.2445 / 0.1956 vs the spec 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20; worst deviation 0.0055, inside the 0.012 tolerance. (Relative to one another the fractions are exact; the uniform shortfall is the deck padding plus 5 flex gaps, which pushes the effects section 29.7 px past the deck content box.)

Reachability measured exactly as specified: for each of the 198 [data-control-id] elements, a 5x5 grid of document.elementFromPoint probes across its bounding box at 1440x900 with window.scrollTo(0,0); reachable only if a probe returns the element or a descendant. 126 of 198 reachable, 72 not.

The 72 unreachable controls are not scattered — they are whole landmark groups pushed below the deck by section content taller than the 215.6 px section box, then painted over by .keybed-shell inside .chassis{overflow:hidden} (artifact/src/styles.css:56). Example: synth-arp-mode renders at y=690 while the synth section ends at y=444; the probe returns a keybed key.

Required landmarks: 26 of 33 present in their section. Missing are organ model switches, organ percussion controls, organ rotary controls, piano model selector, piano timbre controls, piano-detail switches, and the synth LFO/arpeggiator block — all render below the deck and are absent from a 3x screenshot of the deck.

Forbidden elements: 0. Performance is exposed red chassis with no inset plate and no display; organ, piano and effects carry no OLED; program has exactly one primary display and synth one small display (not spanning); no equal-width control grid — sections are grouped under FX1/FX2/AMP-EQ/COMP/DELAY/REVERB/ROTARY and OSC/FILTER/AMP ENV/MOD-LFO/VOICE headers.

Counted [data-key] elements in the served build: 73 total, 43 data-key-color="white", 30 "black", MIDI 28-100 (E1-E7) — matches the Stage 4 73 entry in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.variants.json exactly.
All 73 key rects fall inside the .keybed rect (x=85.64 y=452.27 w=1268.72 h=191.80) with a 0.5 px epsilon — keysInsideKeybed 73/73.
Black-key height fraction = mean black height 116.98 / keybed height 191.80 = 0.6099 against the 0.61 +/-0.03 target. Mean white width 29.51 px, mean black width 17.11 px (0.58 of a white key).
Pressed state is real: pointer, computer keyboard and MIDI note-on each add .is-down and aria-pressed="true" to the matching key, and it clears on release, blur and panic.

Sampled every pixel of the instrument crop from a 1440x900 screenshot of the served build, bucketed to surfaces covering >0.02% of the crop, converted to CIE Lab and matched each reference colour to its nearest rendered surface by CIE76 deltaE.

All five inside deltaE 12: chassisMid #851a25 -> rgb(133,26,37) deltaE 0.13 (0.83% coverage); chassisDark #5a0c13 -> rgb(94,17,24) deltaE 2.16; panelBlueGray #3c424d -> rgb(61,66,77) deltaE 0.38 (0.64%); keyBlack #0b0b0b -> rgb(9,9,9) deltaE 0.46 (2.64%); keyWhite #dcdcdc -> rgb(221,221,221) deltaE 0.48 (4.00%). referenceColorsMatched 5/5.

Real hardware vocabulary is there: knob caps carry a rotating pointer driven by --knob-angle (artifact/src/components/widgets.tsx:88-107), faders sit beside green LED ladders, drawbars carry footage silkscreen (16′ 5⅓′ 8′ 4′ 2⅔′ 2′ 1⅗′ 1⅓′), both OLEDs use a green-phosphor-on-dark treatment with a two-line readout, inset plates have the red perimeter the spec calls for, and the wooden cheeks and "nord / stage 4" silkscreen are present.

Legends are not legible at rendered size: .section-head is 0.55vw (7.9 px at 1440) and control labels render around 5-6 px, so at 1:1 the deck reads as grey texture — the labels only become readable at 3x.

The effects plate is typographically broken: its columns overflow the section (six controls render outside the effects rect) and the legends overlap each other — "COMPRESSOR ON" prints over the DELAY column, "REVERB BRIGHT" over "ROTARY SPEAKER DRIVE", and the rotary column is cut off at the chassis edge.

Where the panel is visible it reports honestly: the program OLED shows page.button plus name ("1.5 | VOX COMBO"), appends "E" the moment anything is edited, shows "STORE 1.5" and "STORE AS | VOX COMBO___" during those flows, "LIVE 1" in Live Mode, and appends the split point "C4" when Split is on. The synth OLED tracks the waveform (SAW -> SINE) and filter/voice mode.

Control positions track their parameters: LED ladders follow fader values, split LEDs appear over MIDI 48 and 60 when those split points are enabled, and every key lights on press from pointer, computer keyboard or MIDI.

Program recall breaks the contract: selecting 1.4 (B3 Gospel) switches the audio to organ (0.51734 RMS, centroid 378 Hz vs 0.01653 / 1833 Hz for the grand) while a full snapshot of all 198 controls shows 0 changed values — organ-on, piano-on, organ-perc-on and rotary-on keep the old state the instrument is no longer in.
On a fresh load the organ section shows its ON LED lit and layer A enabled while producing 0.00000 RMS; only cycling organ-on makes the panel state true.

At 390x844 the silhouette survives: instrument 366.6x122.2 px (widthFraction 0.94, aspect 3.00), all 73 keys still laid out inside a 342.3x51.3 px keybed, section headers ORGAN / PIANO / PROGRAM / SYNTH / LAYER FX still legible, chassis and plate colours unchanged, and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390).

It is not usable: the same 5x5 elementFromPoint probe finds only 32 of 198 controls reachable at 390x844, down from 126 at desktop. The visible deck is two or three rows of buttons per section with labels clipped mid-word ("LA", "LE"), and the PROGRAM dial overlaps the PIANO plate.
The instrument occupies 122 px of an 844 px viewport, centred in empty background, so the collapse is not a space constraint — the deck clips for the same reason it clips at desktop.
